tasks.title: Learning spike: full-text search, text chunking, Gemini / Groq API basics
ac: Given a selected PDF containing the answer, then the response cites that file and page.
Given a question not covered by the files, then the assistant says it was not found in the selected files.
Given Gemini fails, then the answer is produced by Groq or a friendly error is shown, never a stack trace.
Given the 31st question of the day, then the API returns AI_LIMIT_REACHED.

ac: Given a student with an active guardian and a weekly schedule, when the time arrives, then exactly one report is created and delivered.
Given a student without guardians, then the report is delivered to the student.
Given a failed WhatsApp delivery, then it is retried and finally sent by email.

tasks.title: Register / login / refresh: bcrypt hashing, JWT access token + httpOnly refresh cookie (part 1/2)

Given an active link, when the student revokes it, then the guardian can no longer open the student's data (403).
